title: The 9:14 Lights (2/3): Who's On The Stairs?

scenes.narration: Last night... a stranger across the river held up a sign. Don't come here. It's not me turning them on. And then... the stairwell light came on.
scenes.visual: recap: sign, then the stairwell bulb flickering on

scenes.narration: You stand there for a long time. Listening. Nothing comes up the stairs.
scenes.visual: rooftop, you facing the door, Biscuit beside you

scenes.narration: So you do the stupidest thing you've ever done... you go down.
scenes.visual: the door opens, you step into the stairwell

scenes.narration: Every step... the light below you flickers on. Like something knows... where you're going.
scenes.visual: stairwell descending, each landing light turns on ahead

scenes.narration: Twenty three floors. Down... and down... until the lights lead you to the lobby.
scenes.visual: floor numbers counting down 23 to L

scenes.narration: There's nobody there. Just the old security desk... and a screen. Glowing.
scenes.visual: dark lobby, security desk, a glowing terminal

scenes.narration: Words start typing. One letter at a time.
Hello. Night two hundred and twelve. You are still here.
scenes.visual: screen: HELLO. NIGHT 212. YOU ARE STILL HERE.

scenes.narration: Your hands are shaking. You type back... who are you?
I am the city. I keep the lights on... so I can find who is left.
scenes.visual: screen: I AM THE CITY, city map

scenes.narration: Two survivors detected. You... and her.
scenes.visual: map with two blinking dots across the river

scenes.narration: Then the screen flickers. And one last line appears... she is lying to you.
scenes.visual: screen glitches red: SHE IS LYING TO YOU

scenes.narration: Biscuit spins around and barks at the doors. Someone is standing outside. Soaked. Holding the sign.
scenes.visual: glass lobby doors, rain, a figure holding the sign

scenes.narration: So... who do you trust? The machine that kept the lights on... or the stranger who told you to stay away? Tell me in the comments... then watch part three.
scenes.visual: end card: TRUST THE MACHINE or THE STRANGER?
